scope: Independent harness/driver/test review by an agent other than their authors. This reviewer prepared the retained input ZIPs, so their content provenance is not independently certified here. Probe subprocess results are controlled mocks, not extra performance measurements.

checks.name: malformed_child_json_fails
checks.detail: The malformed child result cannot become a passing measurement.

checks.name: malformed_child_stdout_retained
checks.detail: The exact original child stdout/stderr are retained through base64 on JSON decode failure.

checks.name: timeout_fails
checks.detail: Timeout cannot become a passing measurement.

checks.name: timeout_partial_output_retained
checks.detail: The exact partial timeout stdout/stderr, including invalid UTF-8 bytes, are retained through base64.

checks.name: nonzero_exit_fails_and_retains_output
checks.detail: Existing ordinary child-exit failure retention works.

checks.name: expected_refusal_does_not_allow_success
checks.detail: A declared refusal cannot turn an unexpected success into a passing result.

checks.name: encoding_failure_retains_operation_timing
checks.detail: Failed report encoding preserves the operation observation and fails.

checks.name: content_identity_beats_size_mtime
checks.detail: The review mutates only its disposable synthetic input, restoring its mtime; SHA identity detects the drift.

checks.name: reviewed_sources_unchanged
checks.detail: Review wrote only this fresh review directory and disposable temporary probe files.

malformed_json.scope: Parent wall time includes probe startup, standard/runtime imports, manifest read, authoring operation, full result serialization for size/hash, compact probe JSON output and exit. This is not the full CLI transport. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

timeout.scope: Parent wall time includes probe startup, standard/runtime imports, manifest read, authoring operation, full result serialization for size/hash, compact probe JSON output and exit. This is not the full CLI transport. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

nonzero_exit.scope: Parent wall time includes probe startup, standard/runtime imports, manifest read, authoring operation, full result serialization for size/hash, compact probe JSON output and exit. This is not the full CLI transport. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

outcome.detail: result encoding: Object of type set is not JSON serializable

repair_review: fresh_processes retains exact captured bytes on timeout, JSON/schema parse failures, and ordinary nonzero/stderr failures; the prior 8/10 review remains unchanged.
source_review: Operation clocks stop before result serialization and output hashing; serialization clocks are reported separately for public reports. Component operations overlap and must not be summed.

Warm samples occur after setup and input hashing; fresh-process wall timing includes Python startup, imports, manifest parsing, authoring work, serialization and exit. The existing scope text explicitly disclaims cold filesystem caches and full CLI transport.
Unexpected errors, wrong refusal codes, unstable output hashes and preservation drift all prevent a pass. Expected refusal status remains distinct from successful operation status.

Runtime source identity includes pixl Python/JSON sources, benchmark script and configuration. Input inventories include all declared roots without ignored subtrees; manifests are rechecked after measurement.

The wrapper checks exact frozen ZIP membership, per-member size/hash and source/archive identities, writes only new output/temporary roots, and rejects existing output directories. Its source snapshot includes the benchmark and the wrapper itself.
The corrected wrapper selects outputs only when they declare bs, mb or ds; queue-native no longer receives an invalid family report probe. Baseline refusal remains retained.

The new unittest file covers success/child parity, real source drift, newly created files, same-size/same-mtime changes, removed manifests, invalid manifest choices and nonzero CLI configuration exits. It now additionally covers malformed child output/schema and partial timeout bytes; this review independently replays the same two failure classes.
